description: The page's orders, newest first, after the last 30 days' totals (paid sales: gross, stomp.to's fee and what the seller keeps). Each order has its date, id, product, amount, status (Paid, Refunded, Under review, Dispute lost, and To ship for physical orders waiting to go out), the buyer's email and, for physical orders, the state it ships to and whether it shipped. Pass the cursor it gives for the next page. Refunds are made in Stripe. Only the page's owner and admins see sales.

cursor.description: From the end of the last page, for the next one.
